history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration explore ways to systematically review and update the vendor database as well as the financial information of vendors that are selected for award.
history.administration_response: The United Nations Global Marketplace sends three notifications to vendors to upload their latest financial statements annually. The first reminder is sent 90 days after the initial “valid to” date, the second one is sent 120 days after the initial “valid to” date and receipt of the first reminder, and the last one is sent 150 days after the initial “valid to” date and receipt of the second reminder. In addition, the Enabling and Outreach Service sends reminders and follow-up emails to those vendors who have contracts of $10 million and above, requesting them to upload their latest financial statements to allow the Service to reevaluate their financial strengths annually. emails sent from the VRO through the United Nations Global Marketplace to those vendors with contracts of $10 million and above. The Service also checks those vendors whose company names have been changed, so that the re-evaluation of their Level 1 status is completed for all vendors who are synched with Umoja in advance of contract award/extension to minimize the time required for the Service to conduct a full assessment of the vendors. While the Service continues to work with the United Nations Global Marketplace closely to explore the implementation of new features to inactivate non-responsive vendors, the Service has issued a new Category Management App that provides for each category the level of responsiveness of invited bidders to tenders in percentages and those that never respond, so that this is taken into account by procurement officials. The Board is requested to consider the recommendation implemented.
history.board_assessment: The Administration provided all appropriate documentation, and the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
